scope: Whole exterior teaching model. Vessel lumens are hollow; chamber wall volumes are exterior sculptures, not a reconstructed internal septal anatomy. Use the complementary partitioning-v1 cutaways for interior teaching.
style: Original PBR surface maps and studio lighting; Tripo references inspected, not re-used as anatomy
limitations: Illustrative reconstruction; not specimen segmented or clinically validated
Truncated vessels; body circulation is not modeled
Identification colors are not literal fetal oxygen saturation
Independent vessel assemblies overlap at anatomical attachments
